plants.credit_line: Burn jelly plant (Bulbine frutescens), flower close-up. Photo: Pierre Mirosa, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Print-ready 4000x6000 flower close-up with explicit species identification; diagnostic yellow star flowers of this garden burn remedy.

plants.credit_line: Krantz aloe (Aloe arborescens), Lisbon, Portugal. Photo: Diego Delso, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0.
plants.why: Commons Quality image at 5616x3744 showing flowering candelabra habit and leaf rosettes with clear species label.
plants.notes: Preferred over the JMK Magaliesberg cliff habitat shot for sharper whole-plant morphology at print scale.

plants.credit_line: Oval-leaf buchu (Agathosma crenulata), developing and dehisced fruit, Harold Porter National Botanical Garden, Betty's Bay, Western Cape. Photo: SAplants, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: High-resolution SAplants field plate labelled Agathosma crenulata, showing fruit and leaves from Western Cape material.

plants.credit_line: Horsemint (Mentha longifolia subsp. capensis), flowers, Harold Porter National Botanical Garden, Betty's Bay, Western Cape. Photo: SAplants, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Cape subsp. capensis flowers at print-ready resolution, matching southern African garden use of Mentha longifolia.
plants.notes: Commons filename and category are subsp. capensis (Betty's Bay). The page description text inconsistently says subsp. longifolia; credit follows filename, category, and location.

plants.credit_line: Sea rush (Juncus kraussii), Paruna Reserve, Como, NSW, Australia. Photo: John Tann, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0.
plants.why: Clear species-level field photograph of the rush habit used in basketry and mats; licence is CC BY 2.0 (no NC/ND).
plants.notes: No print-ready African nominate photograph found on Commons. Higher-resolution subsp. australiensis plates exist (e.g. Kenraiz kz01) but this file carries a clean species-level label.

plants.credit_line: Sweet thorn (Vachellia karroo; syn. Acacia karroo), flowerheads near Wolmaransstad, North West, South Africa. Photo: SAplants, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Current-name SAplants plate of flowerheads at 4992x3328 from South African veld, not a synonym-only Acacia file.
plants.notes: Filename is vachellia-karroo.jpg (preferred). Synonym Acacia karroo accepted in credit line only.

plants.credit_line: Sausage tree (Kigelia africana), hanging fruit on the Arbre du Retour, Ouidah, Benin. Photo: Ji-Elle, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Diagnostic hanging sausage fruits at 3648x5472 with explicit Kigelia africana identification.
plants.notes: Preferred over the JMK Krantzkloof bole/lichen shot, which does not show fruit or foliage well.

plants.credit_line: Buffalo thorn (Ziziphus mucronata), fruit, Faerie Glen Nature Reserve, Pretoria, Gauteng. Photo: SAplants, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: High-resolution SAplants plate of healthy fruit under the correct species name, print-ready at 4992x3328.
plants.notes: Preferred over File:Ziziphus mucronata 1DS-II 3-0063.jpg, which emphasises fungal gall infection rather than typical fruit.
